UPS + 电池，保证停电仍能工作。: A UPS plus batteries, so it keeps working through mains outages.
做好防雷接地，雷雨季节前重点检查。: Provide lightning protection and grounding, with a thorough check before the thunderstorm season.
定期检测输出功率、驻波比与接收灵敏度。: Check output power, SWR and receive sensitivity periodically.
按当地频率协调结果设定输入 / 输出频差（如 ±5MHz）。: Set the input/output offset according to local frequency coordination (e.g. ±5 MHz).
收发共用天线，需足够收发隔离度（通常 ≥ 80dB）。: Transmit and receive share one antenna, needing sufficient isolation between them (usually ≥ 80 dB).
记录通联日志与故障，便于追溯与排障。: Keep records of the log and of faults, for traceability and troubleshooting.
选高处以扩大覆盖，兼顾电源、天线与馈线条件。: Pick a high site to extend coverage, taking power supply, antenna and feedline conditions into account.
遵守频率协调与执照要求，避免干扰其他台站。: Observe frequency coordination and licence requirements to avoid interfering with other stations.
高增益全向或定向天线，馈线损耗要小。: A high-gain omnidirectional or directional antenna, with low feedline loss.
